description: §6.14.1 rule 1: a `persist=` value other than "local" or "session" — here the deferred "cookie" — is E-PERSIST-STORAGE-UNKNOWN.
rationale: §6.14.1 rule 1: "`persist=` takes exactly one of two values: **`"local"`** (Web `localStorage`) or **`"session"`** (Web `sessionStorage`). … Any other value SHALL be `E-PERSIST-STORAGE-UNKNOWN`." Rule 4: "`persist="cookie"` is DEFERRED (not in this revision)."
